title: TesterReport
description: Tester report: the summary, coverage, and findings fields below. Test patches are computed by the build subgraph from `git diff` after this turn — you do not declare them. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

summary.description: Up to four sentences describing what was tested and which test files were written or touched.

coverage.description: One entry per (Work Package, verification predicate) pair you wrote tests for. Empty when no tests were written.

wp_id.description: The Work Package's story_id (the same id used in the input Work Package JSON).

predicate.description: Verbatim verification predicate text copied from the Work Package.

test_names.description: Fully-qualified test method names whose assertions correspond to this predicate, e.g. 'OrderControllerTest.rejectsNegativeOffset'.

findings.description: Structured Tester findings. Empty list when nothing is amiss. Pick the most specific kind.

kind.description: behavior_mismatch: production code behaviour drifts from the predicate (Fixer can patch). naming_mismatch: classes/methods named differently from expectation; mechanical rename is the fix. unclear_predicate: the predicate is ambiguous or missing. infeasible_predicate: the predicate cannot be satisfied within the brief's stated constraints; short-circuits the Fixer loop and routes to a human gate, so reserve it for genuine planning errors.

wp_id.description: The Work Package's story_id this finding belongs to.

detail.description: Up to two sentences describing the finding.
